summary: Keep healthy running members out of failed state when workspace preparation is blocked

schema.detail: No storage, index, store version or client schema changes. Diagnostics use existing fields.

compatibility.detail: A running member that needs no start, restart or stop continues observation and work delivery when workspace preparation fails, including mr lease admission timeouts. The blocker is recorded on the member as a harness.diagnostic with code render-blocked and status warning, then resolved after preparation succeeds. Blocked evaluations remain eligible for the next pass. Absent members and existing start, restart and stop admission fences still fail closed.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal daemon restart.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback requires no data migration.
